text:
Rae: Who's up for a 'portable handheld showdown' this Sunday afternoon? Think Steam Decks, Switch OLED, Playdate demos, and a mini high-score race. :handheld_game:
Tom: Love that. I can bring my Steam Deck + a couple of spare SD cards.
Ivy: I'll bring my Switch OLED and a pro controller. Also snacks.
Chris: I can demo my handheld dev build if people want a tiny playtest. Quick 10-min rounds.
Zoe: I have a 2-player Playdate game that's chaotic. Also a USB-C hub and a bunch of chargers.
Rae: Thinking 3pm start, living room setup with coffee table leaderboard. If we get noisy we can move to the patio.
Tom: Also happy to run a 10-minute time trial leaderboard for arcade games. I'll bring a stopwatch app and spreadsheet.
Ivy: Is there parking nearby? I might bring extra guests.
Rae: Street parking is fine after 2pm. Please RSVP here so I know how many controllers.
poll-bot: Poll created: "Which handheld event do you want?" Options: Speedrun high-score, Local coop demo, Casual freeplay, Swap & trade. Vote with +1.
Tom: +1 Speedrun high-score, +1 Swap & trade
Ivy: +1 Local coop demo
Chris: +1 Casual freeplay, +1 Local coop demo
Zoe: +1 Swap & trade
Rae: Tally: Speedrun 1, Swap & trade 2, Local coop 2, Casual freeplay 1. Looks like Swap or Coop, we'll do a bit of both.
Tom: I'll bring spare USB-C cables and a battery pack. If you're bringing a Steam Deck, please bring a microSD adapter for quick transfers.
Ivy: Also, labeling your device with a sticky note helps. Last meetup we had a mystery charging cable. :sweat_smile:
Chris: For the dev build demo: short NDAs? Nah, it's fine — just don't leak my secret power-up strat. :zipper_mouth_face:
Zoe: I can bring little price-tags if anyone wants to trade handheld accessories. No big-ticket sales, just swaps.
Rae: Plan: Sunday 3pm, demo rotation schedule, mini swap table, and a snack corner. Address DM. Bring chargers, badges, and patience for bugs. :sparkles:
Ivy: RSVP: me +1 friend (they're into handheld roguelikes)
Tom: RSVP: solo. Might leave early around 6.
Chris: RSVP: solo. Can stay late to help pack cables.
Zoe: RSVP: solo. Bringing tape + labels.
Rae: Great — final reminder Friday. If plans change, update here. See ya for tiny screens and big fun! :video_game:
